summary: Living area is tidy with minor tip-over and impact risks from low accent tables.

hazards.title: Unstable pedestal side table
hazards.detail: Narrow base small pedestal table can easily tip if bumped by running children.
fixSteps: Relocate table against a wall or beside the sofa arm
Swap with a broader-based or heavier side table

hazards.title: Rigid table edge at child height
hazards.detail: Hard marble coffee table edge presents an impact risk during slips or falls.
fixSteps: Attach silicone edge cushions around perimeter
Allow wider clear passage between sofa and table

hazards.title: Glass sliding door collision risk
hazards.detail: Floor-to-ceiling clear glass doors can cause impact injury if closed and unseen.
fixSteps: Apply subtle visual decals at adult and child eye levels
Keep track clear and ensure door slides smoothly

products.name: Clear Edge Protectors
products.reason: Softens sharp table perimeters against child head bumps.

products.name: Glass Safety Decals
products.reason: Prevents people and pets from walking into closed glass doors.
